decisions: Cancellation exactly before commit and cleanup failure stay covered by the fault-injection regression (scripts/check-core.py); they cannot be triggered reliably by hand.
The owning window cannot be closed natively while its task sheet is shown, so owner-close is prevented by the UI; the coordinator regression covers programmatic owner close.
Read errors are covered by EIO injection; real removable-volume and file-provider interruptions, forced termination and power loss move to #217.
boundary: Temporary output inside the app container cannot be listed from another process; for boot-volume scenarios, cleanup is inferred from the primary error being shown instead of the cleanup-failure error. The disk-full scenario verifies cleanup directly on its own volume.
